title: German Yorkshire Pudding with Celery and British Sausage
description: A hearty German-inspired dish that combines the classic British Yorkshire pudding with caramelized celery and robust sausage.
instructions: Caramelize the celery in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the British sausage in a separate pan until browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper.
Add the caramelized celery and cooked sausage to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the robust mustard to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the Yorkshire pudding batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the sausage and celery mixture over the batter in the baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the Yorkshire pudding is golden brown and the sausage is cooked through.
